_comment: Which walk each body plays (user, 2026-09-27). ONE walk exists; a female body plays the copies blender/tools/derive_gait.py writes as f_<clip>, under the BASE names, in its own library. tools/godot/build_character_anims.gd writes the libraries; tools/godot/build_character_visuals.gd points each body's AnimationTree at its gait's. `relaxed` is the clip the relaxed branch plays (AnimationController): a male body strolls on the ordinary walk.

crowd_weights._comment: How often each body appears in the crowd (default 1). Fumiriya is the only male body so far, so he is weighted up to keep the street roughly 3 men in 8.
